### 5. Proof of the main results {.tabset}

:::{.card title="5.1 proof"}

$$
\begin{align*}
P(v \in \text{th}^C A^{y,t} (C_n^{i})) &= E \left[ \frac{\text{th}^C A^{y,t} (C_n^{i})}{A^{y,t} (C_n^{i})}\right] \\
&= E \left[ f(C_n^{i}) \right] \\
&= E \left[ f \left( \frac{n \cdot \Gamma(i, \lambda)}{a_n} \right) \right] \\
&= E \left[ f \left( \Gamma \cdot n^{\frac{3}{5}} \right) \right] && a_n = n^{\frac{2}{5}} \implies \beta = \frac{3}{5}\\
&= E \left[ E \left[ f \left( \Gamma \cdot n^{\frac{3}{5}} \right) \Big| \, \Gamma\right] \right] \\
&\leq E \left[ \sum_{j=1}^{\Gamma \cdot n^\alpha} \frac{c \cdot j}{n} + \sum_{j=\Gamma \cdot n^\alpha}^{\Gamma \cdot n^\beta } \frac{c \cdot n^{\beta - \alpha}}{n} \right]
&& \eta_{su} \leq \pi_u \frac{\Gamma \cdot n^\beta}{\Gamma \cdot n^\alpha} \text{ , the number of } u \text{ type vertices in the whole subtree of } i_j\\ 
& \leq E \left[ \Gamma^2 \cdot n^{2 \alpha - 1} \right] + E \left[ \Gamma \cdot n^{2\beta - \alpha - 1} \right] \\
& = o(1) \left( E \left[ \Gamma^2 \right] + E \left[ \Gamma \right] \right) \\
& = o(1) \left( \frac{i \cdot (i + 1)}{\lambda^2} + \frac{i}{\lambda} \right) \\
\end{align*}
$$

---

$$
\begin{align*}
P(v \in \text{th}^C A^{y,t} (C_n^{\text{con}})) &=
\sum_i P(v \in \text{th}^C A^{y,t} (C_n^{i})) \cdot P(\argmin_j \{ C_n^j = C_n^{\text{con} } \} = i ) \\
&\leq \sum_i P(v \in \text{th}^C A^{y,t} (C_n^{i})) \cdot \left( \frac{\lambda}{\lambda + 1} \right) ^ i \cdot \left( \frac{1}{\lambda + 1} \right) 
&& \text{Lemma } 4.2. \, (\argmin \& \text{Geom})
\end{align*}
$$

---


$$
o(1) \cdot E \left( \frac{\argmin \cdot (\argmin + 1)}{\lambda^2} + \frac{\argmin}{\lambda} \right) \leq
o(1) \cdot \left( 2 \cdot \frac{\left( \lambda + 1 \right)^2}{\lambda^2} + \frac{\lambda + 1}{\lambda} \right) = o(1)
$$


---

Below, we explain where $2 \cdot \frac{\left( \lambda + 1 \right)^2}{\lambda^2} + \frac{\lambda + 1}{\lambda}$ comes from.



$\argmin$ stochastically dominated by $G \sim \text{Geom} \left( \frac{1}{\tilde \lambda + 1} \right) \implies$



$$
\begin{align*}
\mathrm{E} \left[ \text{arg min} ^ 2 \right]  & \leq \mathrm{E} \left[ G^2 \right] \\
& = \mathrm{Var} \left[ G \right] + \mathrm{E} \left[ G \right] ^ 2 \\ 
& = \frac{1 - p}{p^2} + \frac{1}{p^2} && p \, \colon = \frac{1}{\tilde \lambda + 1} \\
& \leq \frac{2}{p^2} \\
& = 2 \left( \tilde \lambda + 1 \right) ^ 2
\end{align*}
$$
